hook.text: Russia targeted the 2016 US presidential election with hacks and social media bots. Democracy became a battlefield.

buildup.text: Election interference is as old as the Cold War. The CIA influenced elections in Italy, Chile, and dozens more nations.

discovery.text: Modern interference uses social media to spread division. You don't need to change votes — just change minds.

twist.text: The US protests when others interfere in its elections — but the CIA has done the same to others for decades.

climax.text: Every major election now faces foreign interference. Defending democracy requires defending information itself.

punchline.text: The cheapest way to defeat a democracy is confusion.

quiz.question: How has election interference changed in the digital age?
options: It now requires military force to be effective
Social media allows influence campaigns to change minds without changing votes
Only authoritarian nations can conduct interference
